quotes.author: Lucas Ochoa
quotes.text: ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ Our group had an awesome experience with my brother that was visiting and friends that I’m stationed with here on island! This was my second time booking with Aloha Charters and I cannot give the crew enough praise for how comfortable they made us all feel and just how fun our experience was! We ended up catching a 135lb blue marlin and a 25lb skipjack tuna! I will definitely recommend anyone who’s thinking of getting a charter to book with Aloha Charters. They will not disappoint! Lucas Ochoa Summer 2025

quotes.author: George Azar
quotes.text: ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ Aloha Charters were genuinely determined to get us on fish, and they did. Our safety was their top priority as we got fish onto the vessel deck. They were clear with instructions that ensured our safety. The icing on the cake was when marlin hit the lure minutes before the end of the day. Overall, I would highly recommend Aloha Charters. I feel confident that the crew will meet everyone’s expectations to the best of their ability. George Azar Summer 2025

quotes.author: Casey Pelzl
quotes.text: ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ These guys took such good care of us and got us on fish in some *not* ideal weather and wind. We’re never expecting anything when we go out fishing (no one can control what the fish are gonna do), but these guys delivered. Mahi, striped marlin, and skipjack – one hell of an afternoon with the boys. Thanks for an awesome day, Casey and Clint!!!! We learned, we laughed, and we are SORE today. Cheers! Casey Pelzl Summer 2025
